root.label: Greg Abbott withdraws endorsement of David Flores

events.label: Greg Abbott withdraws endorsement of David Flores

slots.name: endorsement status
slots.sentence: “There is no place for this kind of behavior or language. Our brave law enforcement officers put their lives on the line every day to keep our communities safe, and Governor Abbott will always stand with the men and women of law enforcement. In light of this conduct, Governor Abbott has withdrawn his endorsement of David Flores.”
